correctness.rationale: Continuity and the common iid null make all balanced pooled-label words equiprobable. Since each empirical mass is a count divided by n, nρ is exactly the minimum Hamming distance to a fitted binary word with at most q label changes: choose a majority label per cell, or conversely use the runs of a fitted word as cells. This independently proves the universal lower bound because changing one label can erase at most two transitions, and proves the exact zero event R≤q+1. Each isolated 1001001 block contains a central singleton flanked by zeros; flipping it removes exactly two transitions at cost one. Disjoint blocks permit independent edits of ceil((R−1−q)_+/2) such singletons when the stated block-count condition holds. A possible one-transition overshoot is permitted because empty cells are allowed. Under fixed composition a prescribed block has probability (n)_3(n)_4/(2n)_7=2^(−7)+O(1/n), and two disjoint blocks have probability 2^(−14)+O(1/n). Thus Var L_n=O(n) and L_n/n→1/448 in probability. The parity-specific run counts follow from positive compositions; Stirling's formula gives local mass asymptotic (πn)^(−1/2) exp(−(r−n−1)^2/n), uniformly on bounded standardized windows for both parities. The stated run variance n(n−1)/(2n−1) follows by summing transition indicator covariances (adjacent mean product n/[2(2n−1)], disjoint n(n−1)/[(2n−1)(2n−3)]), giving tight tails and the Gaussian limit on scale sqrt(n/2). The deficit is O_P(sqrt(n)), so the exact edit formula applies with probability tending to one. After division by sqrt(n), rounding the number of edits is negligible and yields (Z−t)_+/(2sqrt(2)). The exact zero probability is proved separately by the runs event, not by weak convergence at its atom. Independent evaluation of the binomial runs sum in Python reproduced all five displayed rounded probabilities.
residual_risks: The exact near-boundary Hamming formula is conditional on enough isolated blocks, not an identity for arbitrary words or q. The null law needs equal sizes and common continuous sampling; no ties or unequal-sample extension is established.
